title: Gur Papri
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

steps.instruction: In a wok,add ghee & let it melt.
steps.romanUrdu: Karahi mein ghee dal ker melt ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add edible gum,mix well & fry on low flame until it puffs up (approx.2-3 minutes),set aside & let it cool.
steps.romanUrdu: Gond katira dal ker ache mix tarhan mix karein aur halki ancch per puff hunay tak fry ker lein & side per rakh ker thanda ker lein.

steps.instruction: In the same wok,add ghee & let it melt.
steps.romanUrdu: Us he karahi mein ghee dal ker melt ker lein.

steps.instruction: Gradually add wheat flour,mix well & cook on low flame until its fragrant and turns golden brown (12-15 minutes) & stir continuously.
steps.romanUrdu: Thora thora ker ka atta shamil karein aur halki ancch per khushbu aur golden brown color ajanay tak paka lein (12-15 minutes) aur musalsal mix kertay rahein.

steps.instruction: Turn off the flame,add jaggery & mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Chulha bund ker dein aur gur dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Turn on the flame and mix well until jaggery melts (3-4 minutes).
steps.romanUrdu: Chulha on karein aur gur melt hunay tak ache tarhan mix ker lein (3-4 minutes).

steps.instruction: Add cardamom powder,crush fried edible gum with the help of hands and add it in wok.
steps.romanUrdu: Elaichi powder dal dein aur fried gond ko haathon ki madad sa crush ker lein aur karahi mein dal dein.

steps.instruction: Add desiccated coconut,almonds,cashew nuts,pistachios & mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Khopra,badam,kaju aur pista dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.
Ghee dal ker ache tarhan mix karein.

steps.instruction: On a greased baking tray,add gur mixture,spread evenly and press gently.
steps.romanUrdu: Greased baking tray per gur ka mixture dal ker evenly pheela lein aur gently press ker lein.

steps.instruction: Cut into desired pieces and let it set for 4 hours & serve!
steps.romanUrdu: Desired pieces mein cut ker lein aur 4 hours set hunay kliya chor dein & serve karein!

steps.instruction: Can be stored in an airtight container for up to 1 month.
steps.romanUrdu: 1 month tak air container mein dal ker store ker saktay han.

ogDescription: Winter special Gur Papdi Recipe for you today. #HappyCookingToYou #FoodFusion
